# SpotLight

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("SpotLight")`

A light that shines in a cone around its forward direction. Parented to a `BasePart` or an `Attachment`, it shines from there, turned by its own `CFrame`, and moves with it. Parented to anything else, it shines from its own `CFrame`.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Angle` | `number` | — | read/write | The full width of the cone, in degrees. |
| `Brightness` | `number` | — | read/write | How much light is emitted. At 0 the light emits nothing. |
| `CFrame` | `CFrame` | — | read/write | The position and direction of the light. When the light is parented to a `BasePart` or an `Attachment`, this is relative to that parent, and the identity puts the light at the parent. Otherwise it is in world space. |
| `Color` | `Color3` | — | read/write | The color of the light, multiplied by `Brightness`. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the light shines. A disabled light does not count toward the limit on lights drawn at once; a light with a `Brightness` of 0 does. |
| `Range` | `number` | — | read/write | The distance, in meters, beyond which the light has no effect. |
| `Shadows` | `boolean` | — | read/write | Whether the light casts shadows.<br><br>A spot light's shadow uses one of the sixteen tiles in the shadow atlas. A `PointLight` uses six, and both kinds share the same atlas.<br><br>When more lights ask for shadows than there are tiles, the lights that are nearest and largest on screen cast them and the others do not. The choice is stable from frame to frame, so shadows do not flicker. |
